says: Sonnet builds with a Haiku worker; Sonnet repairs in the same session

findings: src/tanks.js:13–24 lets tank separation push the player inside an inner wall: place computer at (-12,8), player at (-10.2,10) heading 270, then hold W for 0.5 seconds.
src/shells.js:63 misses grazing hits between steps: firing from (0,0) heading 0 past the computer at (10,1.449) leaves its health at 100 despite contact.

src/shells.js:29–40 falsely bounces corner near-misses: firing from (-10.508147545,6.108147545) heading 315 bounces although the trajectory clears the wall corner by 0.282843 units, exceeding the shell radius.
src/input.js:19 stops movement when W is released while ArrowUp remains held because both keys share one action boolean.
src/input.js:14–19 and src/sim.js:10–11 fire a queued Space press even when Space was released before the paused simulation advances, violating held-key sampling.
Nonblocking suggestion: src/nav.js:19–20 should reuse geom.js's existing clamp function because it already implements the same bounds calculation.

src/shells.js checks wall overlap only at step endpoints, so firing from (-10.389464826, 6.050053570) at heading 315 lets the shell pass within 0.24 units of the wall corner (-9, 5) without bouncing despite its 0.25 radius.

src/shells.js uses a strict inequality for tank hits, so a shell fired from (0, 0) at heading 0 passes tangentially through a computer tank at (10, 1.45) without damage or removal, contrary to the requirement that touching a tank counts as a hit.
src/input.js and src/sim.js clear Space after one step, so holding it never fires again after the cooldown, contrary to the held-key requirement.
src/shells.js ignores exact wall tangencies: firing from (-15, 4.75) at heading 0 passes along the inner wall at z=5 with bounces=0 instead of counting the contact.
